verdict.rationale: Fastmail has a first-party 'Templates' help article, so saved reusable message templates are a documented feature. The evidence pack contains only the article title, with no detail on how templates are inserted into replies, whether they support variables or placeholders, or whether attachments are kept. Missing for 10: evidence of variable/placeholder substitution, evidence that templates preserve attachments, detail on inserting templates into replies, independent or hands-on corroboration.
